mapper.insert: INSERT INTO dream_content (id, user_id, title, content, emotion, place, time, interpretation, analysis_status, analysis_error, image_url, created_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{userId}, #{title}, #{content}, #{emotion}, #{place}, #{time}, #{interpretation}, #{analysisStatus}, #{analysisError}, #{imageUrl}, NOW())
mapper.select: SELECT id, user_id as userId, title, content, emotion, place, time, interpretation, analysis_status as analysisStatus, analysis_error as analysisError, image_url as imageUrl, created_at as createdAt FROM dream_content WHERE user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY created_at DESC

SELECT id, user_id as userId, title, content, emotion, place, time, interpretation, analysis_status as analysisStatus, analysis_error as analysisError, image_url as imageUrl, created_at as createdAt FROM dream_content
ORDER BY created_at DESC, id DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
mapper.update: UPDATE dream_content SET title = #{title}, content = #{content}, emotion = #{emotion}, place = #{place}, time = #{time}, interpretation = '', analysis_status = 'NONE', analysis_error = NULL WHERE id = #{id}
